test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Hema can do a certain piece of work in 21 days. Hema and Raji can together do the same work in 18 days, and Hema, Raji and Smitha can do the same work together in 14 days. In how many days can Hema and Smitha do the same work, working together?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The LCM of 21, 14, and 18 is 126.

Work done Hema in one day = 126/21 = 6 

Work done (Hema + Raji) in one day = 126/18 = 7

Work done (Hema + Raji + Smitha) in one day = 126/14 = 9 

Work done by Raji in one day = 8 - 7 = 1

Work done by Hema and Smitha in one day = 9 - 1 = 8

Hema and Smitha will don in = 126/8 = 63/4 days

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
